titel: RD900-RD914 – Redevelopment between the Mailloles roundabout and the Mas Rouma roundabout – OA2 and OA2bis
kurzbeschreibung: Construction of two engineering structures as part of the redevelopment of a road link in Perpignan.
umfang: Construction works for the realization of the engineering structures OA2 and OA2bis as part of the redevelopment of the RD900 and RD914 between two roundabouts. No specific information on structure type, spans, dimensions, materials or quantities is given in the notice. Contract duration 10 months including 1 month for site preparation.
leistungen: Construction execution for two engineering structures or road civil engineering structures; unit price contract; execution of construction works including site preparation.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• These are engineering structures in a road context, generally within sbp’s field of interest.
• However, the notice concerns purely construction works and no design or checking services.
• Essential technical information such as structure type, spans, structural system or architectural features is missing.
• No explicit design component is apparent in the suitability or award criteria.
• Therefore only limited strategic relevance for sbp despite possible bridge relevance.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the tender. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of information on structure type, number of spans, spans, foundations, materials, quantities and traffic management. These are two engineering structures as part of a road redevelopment with a construction period of 10 months; this indicates a medium construction volume, but a realistic euro estimate is not reliably possible on the basis of the notice.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee information available. As only construction works are tendered and no separate design scope for structural or object planning is mentioned, an sbp-relevant fee cannot be derived from the notice.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Self-declaration that no grounds for exclusion apply; proof of compliance with employment obligations under labour law; information on total turnover and turnover with comparable services for the last three financial years; bank reference or proof of professional indemnity insurance; list of works carried out in the last five years with certificates of proper execution for the most important projects, stating amount, period and place; information on equipment, materials and technical resources; information on average annual number of employees and management staff for the last three years.
auftraggeber: CONSEIL DEPARTEMENTAL DES PYRENEES-ORIENTALES, 24 quai Sadi Carnot, 66906 Perpignan, France. Contact person: MALHERBE Hermeline. E-mail: correspondre@aws-france.com. Website: http://www.ledepartement66.fr/
notes: Notice as an open procedure for construction works. Variants are permitted. Electronic submission required. Option for subsequent award of similar services provided. Social and environmental performance conditions according to the tender documents. Financing: Département 61 %, Perpignan Méditerranée Métropole 19.5 %, City of Perpignan 19.5 %.
